items.label: Hybrid Active Noise Cancelling
items.value: Noise cancelling headphones block up to 95% of ambient noise with a 4-layer hybrid ANC system. An ultra-fast ANC chip delivers up to 45dB noise reduction in just 0.02s, minimizing distractions the moment ANC is activated. Switch to Transparency Mode to stay aware of your surroundings for hearing announcements, traffic, or colleagues while maintaining crystal-clear audio for music, calls, or games, making it perfect for commuting, offices, or focused sessions.

items.label: 120H Playback with Digital Battery Display
items.value: Wireless headphones deliver up to 120 hours of continuous playback on a single charge. Quick charge for 10 minutes provides about 3 hours of listening, so you can get back to music or calls instantly. The digital battery display of noise cancelling headphones shows precise remaining power at a glance and auto turns off after 3 seconds, removing guesswork. Perfect for travel, work, or extended listening sessions anytime, anywhere.

items.label: 6-Mic ENC Calls & 360° Spatial Sound
items.value: 6 adaptive ENC mics ensure face-to-face call clarity even in noisy streets, cafes, or open offices by reducing traffic, wind, and crowd noise. Combined with 40mm dynamic drivers and immersive 360° spatial audio, sound surrounds you and flows naturally in every direction. Bluetooth headphones turn your favourite content into a 3D listening experience, bringing music, games, and films to life with rich detail. Don’t just listen. Experience.

items.label: Bluetooth 6.0 & AUX Wired Mode
items.value: Advanced Bluetooth 6.0 over ear headphones deliver faster pairing, stronger, more stable connections, and ultra-low latency down to 35ms, with up to 2× faster data transmission than standard headphones bluetooth across phones, tablets, and computers. Prefer wired headphones? Switch instantly via the 3.5mm AUX cable for true lossless audio, ideal for gaming, studio work, or flights. Freely transition between wireless earbuds convenience and wired precision.

items.label: Velvet-Like Cloud Comfort & Faux Leather Texture Design
items.value: Foldable earcups enable compact portability, with an adjustable headband designed to fit all head sizes securely. Ergonomic over the ear headphones are wrapped in velvet-like protein leather and cushioned with soft, resilient memory foam to relieve pressure and ensure all-day comfort—ideal for long work sessions, commuting, or extended gaming. A premium grained exterior texture adds an elegant, refined look and improved grip.
